title: Peshawar Considers Routes and Timings for Bike Ride-Hailing
excerpt: The administration in Peshawar is planning to set designated routes and fixed operating hours for motorcycle ride-hailing services.
body_html:
The administration in Peshawar has announced plans to introduce designated routes and fixed operating hours for motorcycle ride-hailing services operating within the area.

According to the administration, these proposed measures aim to regulate the bike-hailing sector by establishing specific schedules and pathways for drivers and passengers.
